title: ChainAlert
features: Customizable threshold + filter rules per entity

bottomTabBar.note: Exactly 3 tabs in this order. Feed = activity/bell icon, Tracked = eye/watchlist icon, Settings = gear icon. Active tab in vivid emerald accent, inactive tabs neutral grey. Reused verbatim on the three primary screens only.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Light near-white top area, screen title in bold, optional live green dot chip indicating real-time stream connected.

screens.name: onboarding-welcome
screens.purpose: First launch, introduce the app value: never miss an on-chain event
screens.content: Full-bleed hero with abstract blockchain node graphic, headline 'Never miss an on-chain move', subcopy about sub-2-second alerts, page dots (step 1 of 4), primary emerald 'Get Started' button, small 'Skip' link

screens.name: onboarding-track
screens.purpose: Explain tracking wallets, tokens, and contracts
screens.content: Illustration of a wallet + token cards, headline 'Track any wallet, token or contract', three example chips (Vitalik.eth, USDC, Uniswap V3), page dots step 2 of 4, 'Continue' button

screens.name: onboarding-rules
screens.purpose: Explain customizable threshold and filter rules
screens.content: Illustration of a rule builder, headline 'Set your own alert rules', example rule card 'Transfer > $50,000', toggle chips (Large transfers, New mints, Whale moves), page dots step 3 of 4, 'Continue' button

screens.name: onboarding-notifications
screens.purpose: Request push notification permission for instant delivery
screens.content: Bell illustration, headline 'Get alerts in under 2 seconds', subcopy, mock iOS notification preview card 'Whale moved 1,200 ETH', page dots step 4 of 4, 'Enable Notifications' emerald button, 'Not now' link

screens.name: paywall
screens.purpose: RevenueCat paywall with free trial before entering the app
screens.content: Headline 'Start your 7-day free trial', feature checklist (Unlimited tracked entities, Real-time alerts, Custom rules, Priority push), two plan cards (Yearly $59.99 best value badge, Monthly $9.99), 'Start Free Trial' emerald CTA, restore purchases + terms links, small 'then $59.99/yr' note

screens.name: feed
screens.purpose: Primary real-time feed of on-chain alert events
screens.content: Header 'Feed' with live green dot 'Live', filter segmented control (All, Whales, Mints, Transfers), scrollable alert cards each with token/wallet avatar, event title 'Whale moved 1,200 ETH ($4.1M)', entity name 'Vitalik.eth', relative time '12s ago', threshold tag, tx hash preview, unread accent dot

screens.name: alert-detail
screens.purpose: Detail of a single on-chain alert event
screens.content: Back header, event headline 'Large ETH transfer', amount $4.1M / 1,200 ETH, from/to address rows with copy icons, matched rule chip 'Transfer > $1M', block number + timestamp, gas fee, 'View on Etherscan' outline button, 'Mute this entity' secondary action

screens.name: tracked-entities
screens.purpose: Primary watchlist of tracked wallets, tokens, contracts
screens.content: Header 'Tracked' with '+' add button, search field, segmented tabs (Wallets, Tokens, Contracts), list rows each with avatar, name 'Vitalik.eth', address short '0x2b6...45f', active rules count '3 rules', 24h alert count badge, right chevron

screens.name: add-entity
screens.purpose: Modal to add a new wallet, token, or contract to track
screens.content: Modal sheet header 'Track new entity', type selector (Wallet / Token / Contract), address or ENS input '0x... or name.eth', suggested chips (Vitalik.eth, PEPE, Blur), starter rule toggle 'Alert on transfers > $100k', emerald 'Add to watchlist' button

screens.name: entity-detail
screens.purpose: Detail of one tracked entity with its stats and rules
screens.content: Header with avatar + 'Vitalik.eth' + address copy, stat row (Balance $28.4M, 24h alerts 7, Rules 3), recent alerts mini list, 'Alert rules' section preview with rule cards, 'Add rule' link, 'Remove from watchlist' destructive text button

screens.name: alert-rules
screens.purpose: Configure threshold and filter rules for an entity
screens.content: Header 'Alert rules', list of rule cards each with condition 'Transfer amount > $50,000', event-type toggles (Transfers, Mints, Swaps, Approvals), threshold slider with USD value, direction selector (In / Out / Both), 'Save rule' emerald button, delete rule swipe hint

screens.name: settings
screens.content: Header 'Settings', account card (avatar, email, PRO badge), sections: Notifications (push toggle, quiet hours), Subscription (Manage plan row), Data & streams (Connected: Alchemy webhook, Refresh watchlist), Appearance, About, Sign out

screens.name: subscription-manage
screens.content: Header 'Subscription', current plan card 'Pro Yearly - renews Feb 12, 2027', price $59.99/yr, benefits checklist, 'Change plan' options (Yearly / Monthly), 'Restore purchases', 'Cancel subscription' destructive link, billing managed by App Store note
